{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of severity by sex
print("Severity distribution by sex:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity']))

# Check the distribution of severity by arm
print("\nSeverity distribution by arm:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity']))

# Check response rate by sex, stratified by severity
print("\nResponse rate by sex and severity:")
print(trial_df.groupby(['sex', 'severity'])['responded'].mean())"}
